en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing rows of young thornless cactus plants in trays in the foreground and larger prickly pear cactus plants growing in neat rows in the background. The image appears printed on the left side of the card with a light border. Below the photograph is a caption in red ink describing the scene and location, with an additional handwritten number in red at the lower right.
